apps.description:
AfterSleep is a privacy-friendly Android app that lets users delay media playback until after they fall asleep.

Instead of starting music, podcasts, audiobooks, or videos immediately, AfterSleep can pause active playback and automatically resume it later after a configurable delay.

The app works with Android media sessions and supports many media apps.

Features:

* Delayed playback start
* Optional automatic stop timer
* Foreground service reliability
* AMOLED-friendly dark interface
* Offline operation
* No ads
* No tracking
* No account required

AfterSleep is designed as a calm and minimal sleep companion focused on reliability and privacy.
apps.summary: Delayed media playback companion for sleep

en-US.description:
AfterSleep is a Kotlin + Jetpack Compose Android app for delayed media playback control.

Set a timer to automatically pause or resume media playback while you sleep. The app runs a foreground service for reliable timers and uses Notification listener support for active session detection.

Highlights:
â€¢ Dark-only Material 3 UI
â€¢ MediaSessionManager and MediaController based playback control
â€¢ Foreground service for reliable timers
â€¢ Notification listener support for active session detection
â€¢ MVVM architecture with StateFlow and coroutines
â€¢ Settings for default delay, stop-after, dim screen, monochrome mode, and fallback behavior
en-US.name: AfterSleep
en-US.summary: Set a timer to automatically pause or resume media playback while you sleep.

apps.description:
SBSkip is a SponsorBlock-powered media cleaner for Android.

Select a local video or audio file, provide the corresponding YouTube URL,
and SBSkip will retrieve SponsorBlock segments and create a cleaned copy
with sponsor segments removed.

Features:

* SponsorBlock integration
* Local video and audio file processing
* Background processing with WorkManager
* Material 3 user interface
* Persistent settings with DataStore
* FFmpeg-based media trimming
* No account required

SBSkip processes media locally on the device. No YouTube account or API key
is required.
apps.summary: Remove SponsorBlock segments from local video and audio files

en-US.description:
SB Skip helps you remove SponsorBlock-marked segments from videos and audio files you already have on your device.

Many apps can download media, but the resulting files still contain sponsored messages, self-promotion, interaction reminders, intros, outros, and other segments that SponsorBlock users have identified. SB Skip cleans those files after download, creating a new version with unwanted sections removed.

Features:

â€¢ Remove SponsorBlock segments from existing video and audio files
â€¢ Supports videos and audio shared from other apps
â€¢ Paste a YouTube URL to retrieve SponsorBlock segment information
â€¢ Queue multiple cleaning jobs for background processing
â€¢ Configure which SponsorBlock categories should be removed
â€¢ Persistent queue with progress tracking and notifications
â€¢ Separate settings for output behavior and file handling
â€¢ Material 3 user interface
â€¢ Translation-ready and fully open source

Supported SponsorBlock categories include:

â€¢ Sponsor segments
â€¢ Self-promotion
â€¢ Interaction reminders (like, subscribe, etc.)
â€¢ Intros
â€¢ Outros
â€¢ Preview/recap sections
â€¢ Filler content
â€¢ Music off-topic sections
â€¢ And other categories provided by SponsorBlock

How it works:

1. Select or share a media file with SB Skip.
2. Provide the corresponding YouTube URL.
3. SB Skip retrieves SponsorBlock segment data.
4. Unwanted segments are removed from the media file.
5. A cleaned copy is saved to your device.

SB Skip does not download videos. It is designed to work with media files you already possess and uses the community-maintained SponsorBlock database to determine which sections should be removed.

SB Skip is free software and respects user choice by allowing complete control over which segment categories are processed.
en-US.name: SB Skip
en-US.summary: Remove SponsorBlock segments from downloaded videos and audio files.

apps.description: A simple LAN chat app built using Flutter. It allows users to chat with each other over a local network without the need for an internet connection. The app uses UDP sockets for communication and supports text messaging.

en-US.description:
Secret Chat is a local area network (LAN) messaging application that allows you to chat with friends and colleagues without an internet connection. Perfect for conferences, offices, events, or any situation where you need secure, private communication within a local network.

Features:
â€¢ No Internet Required - Chat over your local WiFi or mobile hotspot
â€¢ Privacy Focused - Messages stay on your local network
â€¢ Multiple Security Options - Protect your rooms with passwords, PINs, or pattern locks
â€¢ Dark Theme - Easy on the eyes with built-in dark mode
â€¢ App Lock - Biometric or screen lock protection for the entire app
â€¢ Hidden Rooms - Create private rooms that don't appear in the room list
â€¢ Message History - Messages persist while the app is running, cleared when closed
â€¢ Material Design 3 - Modern, clean interface

How to Use:
1. Choose "Host Network" to create a room and share as the host
2. Or choose "Use Wi-Fi" to browse and join existing rooms
3. Optionally protect your room with a password, PIN, or pattern
4. Start chatting - all communication stays within your local network

Security:
- All communication happens locally on your WiFi network
- No data transmitted to external servers
- Messages are not stored permanently
- Supports biometric authentication
- Pattern lock option for additional security

Perfect for:
â€¢ Office communications and quick collaboration
â€¢ Conferences and events
â€¢ Classroom discussions
â€¢ LAN parties and gaming events
â€¢ Emergency communication when internet is unavailable
â€¢ Privacy-conscious users who want local control
en-US.name: Secret Chat
en-US.summary: LAN chat without internet - secure, private, instant messages

apps.description:
Smart Ringtone automatically changes contact-specific ringtones based on your call history.

The app tracks missed, rejected, incoming, and outgoing calls, assigning a score to each contact. As a contact's score changes, Smart Ringtone can automatically update their ringtone, helping important callers stand out.

Features:

* Automatic contact ringtone assignment
* Configurable ringtone priority levels
* Call score tracking based on call activity
* Support for missed, rejected, incoming, and outgoing calls
* Contact score management and reset controls
* Local processing with no account required
* No internet connection required

Smart Ringtone uses Android's built-in contact ringtone functionality and performs all processing on the device. No call logs, contacts, or personal information are transmitted to external servers.

Required permissions:

* Contacts - to read and update contact ringtone settings
* Phone State - to detect call state changes
* Call Logs - to process call activity and update scores
apps.summary: Automatically adjust contact ringtones based on call activity

apps.description: A simple volume lock app built using Flutter. It allows users to lock their device's volume level and prevent accidental changes.

en-US.description:
Volume Lock gives you fine-grained control over your Android audio behavior with two core features:

- Volume Lock: when the screen turns off, current media, ring, notification, and alarm volumes are locked and automatically restored if changed.
- App Volume Lock: saves and restores media volume for selected apps when you return to them.

Key highlights:
- Tracks and restores audio levels automatically
- Lets you choose which apps participate in App Volume Lock
- Keeps behavior consistent after reboot

Permissions:
- Do Not Disturb / Notification Policy access is needed to lock ring and notification volumes on Android 6+
- Accessibility service is needed to detect foreground app changes for App Volume Lock

Built with Flutter
en-US.name: Volume Lock
en-US.summary: Lock device volume profiles and auto-restore per-app media volume.
